title: Nutritional drink or shake, ready-to-drink (Slim Fast)

content.title: About
content.content: Slim Fast nutritional drink is a ready‑to‑drink shake designed to support weight management. It provides a balanced mix of protein, carbohydrates, vitamins, and minerals, delivering satiety with low calories.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Slim Fast has been on the market for over 40 years and is one of the most recognized diet‑brand names.
The product is available in several flavors, including chocolate, vanilla, and strawberry.
Each serving typically contains about 200 calories, making it suitable as a meal replacement.
The drink requires no preparation – just open and enjoy.

items.title: Weight‑control support
items.content: Low calorie content and high protein help maintain fullness and reduce overall calorie intake.

items.title: Quick energy boost
items.content: A blend of fast‑acting carbs and protein provides rapid energy after consumption.

items.title: Vitamin‑mineral complex
items.content: Includes B‑vitamins, vitamin C, iron, and calcium to support overall health.

items.title: Convenient usage
items.content: Ready‑to‑drink format is handy for travel, work, and on‑the‑go situations.

items.title: Dairy allergy
items.content: Some varieties contain dairy protein, which may trigger reactions in allergic individuals.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Although low‑calorie, certain flavors contain added sugars.

items.title: Not a complete diet substitute
items.content: Relying solely on shakes can lead to deficiencies in fiber and other nutrients.

content.title: How to Use
content.content: Shake the bottle, open, and drink immediately. It is recommended as a single daily meal replacement, paired with fruits or vegetables for a balanced intake.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Once opened, consume within 24 hours.
